description:
The description of development for the householder permission is as follows: 

"External alterations including the rebuilding of rear ground floor scullery and introduction of a rear extension at 1st floor, the introduction of a rear 1st floor terrace and raising of the 1st floor parapet (Cheltenham Terrace), the replacement and introduction of mansard roof at 3rd floor, construction of a small rear brick extension to accommodate a lift, alterations to windows at ground floor level (lowering sills), introduction of slim profile double glazing, and associated refurbishment works to external elevations”.

The description of development for development for the listed building consent is as follows: 

"External alterations including the rebuilding of rear ground floor scullery and introduction of a rear extension at 1st floor, the introduction of a rear 1st floor terrace and raising of the 1st floor parapet (Cheltenham Terrace), the replacement and introduction of mansard roof at 3rd floor, construction of a small rear brick extension to accommodate a lift, alterations to windows at ground floor level (lowering sills), introduction of slim profile double glazing, and associated refurbishment works to external elevations. Internal works of refurbishment comprising the reinstatement of original openings, plan form and associated works to facilitate use as a single-family dwelling."
